# BakerHostetler Team Represents Woodruff Sawyer in Sale to Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. for $1.2 Billion

Partners Tony Roehl and Lori Bibb led a team that included Associates Madison Alexander, Katie O’Brien and Brittany Schwabe as they represented independent insurance brokerage and consulting firm Woodruff Sawyer in its sale to Arthur J. Gallagher & Co., a public global insurance brokerage, risk management and consulting services firm, for $1.2 billion. The deal closed April 10, 2025.

San Francisco-based Woodruff Sawyer provides a full suite of commercial property/casualty products, employee benefit solutions and risk management services, focusing on middle and large market clients. The sale will expand Illinois-based Gallagher’s presence in the West Coast market.

Other team members who assisted on the transaction include Partners Craig Carpenter, Brian Harris, Thomas Hogan, Numan Siddiqi, Stefan Smith and Matthew Wochok, Counsels Jon Knight and Meagan Moore, and Associates Tanner Daniels, Colson Ginger, Jeffrey Liskov, Jarret Mendoza and Miranda Owens.

deepseek.snippet:
# Arthur J. Gallagher Completes Buy of Woodruff Sawyer

Just over a month since insurance brokerage Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. said it had a definitive agreement in place to buy Woodruff Sawyer for $1.2 billion, the deal is closed.

Gallagher said April 10 that the acquisition of San Francisco-based Woodruff Sawyer, announced early March, is complete.

According to previously released details, Woodruff Sawyer CEO Andy Barrengos will operate under the direction of Peter Doyle, head of Gallagher’s U.S. retail property/casualty brokerage operations.

The deal follows Gallagher’s much larger late 2024 agreement to acquire AssuredPartners for $13.45 billion for add to its middle-market reach. The AssuredPartners buy has yet to be completed. In March, Gallagher said the Federal Trade Commission requested more information and that the transaction is now expected to close in the second half of 2025.

Woodruff Sawyer’s 600 or so employees offer commercial property/casualty products, employee benefits solutions, and risk management services from 14 U.S. offices and one U.K. office.

Employee-owned Woodruff Sawyer ranked 24th in Insurance Journal’s 2024 Top 100 Independent Property/Casualty Agencies, with P/C revenue of about $214.7 million. Orlando, Florida-based AssuredPartners ranked fifth on Insurance Journal‘s list.

linkup.title: Arthur J. Gallagher Completes Buy of Woodruff Sawyer
linkup.snippet:
Just over a month since insurance brokerage Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. said it had a definitive agreement in place to buy Woodruff Sawyer for $1.2 billion, the deal is closed.  
Gallagher said April 10 that the acquisition of San Francisco-based Woodruff Sawyer, [announced early March](https://www.insurancejournal.com/news/national/2025/03/04/814206.htm), is complete.  
According to previously released details, Woodruff Sawyer CEO Andy Barrengos will operate under the direction of Peter Doyle, head of Gallagher’s U.S. retail property/casualty brokerage operations.
Woodruff Sawyer’s 600 or so employees offer commercial property/casualty products, employee benefits solutions, and risk management services from 14 U.S. offices and one U.K. office.  
Employee-owned Woodruff Sawyer ranked 24th in *Insurance Journal’s* [2024 Top 100 Independent Property/Casualty Agencies](https://www.insurancejournal.com/top-100-insurance-agencies/), with P/C revenue of about $214.7 million.

octen.snippet: With the strong underwriting results posted by carriers during 2025, which was helped by a quiet U.S. wind season, there was plenty of reinsurance capacity to support client demand. The property reinsurance market saw rate decreases in the teens, with lower layers holding up better than the top end of reinsurance towers. We saw some continued demand for more cover and increased purchasing by clients. J. Patrick Gallagher, Jr.Chairman and CEO at Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.00:04:42In fact, despite double-digit price declines for property CAT globally, property reinsurance premiums were down only mid to high single digits relative to last year. Within specialty lines, marine and energy experienced increased carrier competition. Pricing across casualty lines continued to be broadly stable because most reinsurers remained very cautious of U.S.-focused casualty risks. Looking ahead, we expect the buyer's market will persist through 2026, absent any outsized current year or prior year loss activity. While clients are comfortable with their purchased reinsurance programs at 1/1, we believe it is likely that some carriers will explore buying additional protection to further reduce earnings volatility or support growth throughout 2026. Moving to Employee Benefits, we continue to see strong demand for our services as clients manage rising health insurance costs. J. Patrick Gallagher, Jr.Chairman and CEO at Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.00:05:39Medical costs are expected to be up high single digits again in 2026, driven by increased utilization, provider consolidation, and newer high-cost treatments and therapies.

Overall, reinsurers were able to meet increased client demand with sufficient capacity while remaining disciplined on terms. ## Wallpaper removal across Chicagoland, walls left ready for what comes next

Old paper and adhesive stripped patiently, the wall underneath protected, then smoothed and prepped for paint or new paper. Based in Highland Park, serving the North Shore and Chicagoland.

1. Home
1. Wallpaper Removal

## We take the paper off and protect the wall underneath.

Wallpaper removal can damage the wall underneath. A rushed strip gouges the surface, tears the paper facing off the drywall and leaves adhesive that ghosts through every coat of paint afterward.

We strip paper and adhesive, protect the wall underneath, then smooth and prep the surface for paint or new paper.

What Happens Next

## Paint it, or paper it again

Once the wall is clean and smooth, it is ready for whatever comes next. Either way the wall is left prepped.

### Paint It

Most rooms get a fresh coat through our interior painting work, on a wall that is finally flat.

### Paper It Again

Others get new paper through our wallpaper installation, hung on a smooth, primed surface.

## Old homes, old paper

In older homes it's common to find paper over paper, or paper painted over years ago. Each layer needs its own approach, and the wall behind it is sometimes plaster that needs care. We plan for that at the walkthrough and price it in the estimate.

North Shore Homes

## Paper on plaster

Many North Shore homes have paper hung on plaster, sometimes decades ago. Plaster takes water and steam differently than drywall, and an aggressive strip can damage it.

We work in Highland Park, Lake Forest, Glencoe, Winnetka, Wilmette and across the North Shore, and travel throughout Chicagoland for the right project.
